Definition: a Karmite or descendant of Karmi
BiblicalUsage: Karmiy is a Karmite — a descendant of Karmi, of the sons of Reuben. The census of the second generation names the family of the Carmites, one of the families counted in the wilderness before the entry into the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the census kept every family: the Karmites are named once, and the God who counts His people counts them all.
